paragraphs: The XJ6 was a core part of the Jaguar XJ range from 1994 to 2003, spanning the X300 and X308 generations. Across both, it used the AJ16 — a 3.2‑ to 4.0‑litre inline‑6 petrol engine. This was Jaguar’s final straight‑six before the switch to V8s, and it remains a respected unit for its smoothness and character. The XJ6 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Jaguar XJ6 Engine Compatibility Because the XJ6 uses the same AJ16 engine family across both generations, compatibility is straightforward once we confirm the exact variant and year. However, there were running changes during production, so we always verify your specific engine by registration or VIN before quoting or sourcing any parts. This ensures we fit the correct timing components, gaskets and ancillaries for your exact build. The XJ6 uses the AJ16 — a 3.2‑ to 4.0‑litre inline‑6 petrol engine. It was fitted from 1994 to 2003 across the X300 and X308 generations. How much does a Jaguar XJ6 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £3,200 for the AJ16. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed‑price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my XJ6? All XJ6 models use the AJ16. We’ll confirm your exact spec by registration to ensure we quote the right parts. Do you rebuild AJ16 XJ6 engines? Yes. We rebuild the AJ16 to a near‑new standard, replacing worn components with updated OEM parts, and back it with a 12‑month unlimited‑mileage warranty. Do you supply used XJ6 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low‑mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we’ve matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my XJ6 if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does an XJ6 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3‑5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most XJ6 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit’s history, and comes with a 12‑month unlimited‑mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XJ6 from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
